screens.content: The warehouse closes each order with a clear calculation. On form 42-B, Rina writes: 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4; -7 + 15 = 8; and 12 * 8 = 96. Theo compares each figure with the picking sheet, then checks that the order number and customer name match the signed receipt. Rina notices a smudged digit in the first total, checks the original invoice, and corrects it before the form is scanned. They file the signed page with the delivery record and place a copy in the monthly folder. Rina also records the shelf location, the delivery time, and the initials of the colleague who checked the count.

screens.content: At closing time, Rina completes the final form for the shift. She writes 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4, -7 + 15 = 8, and 12 * 8 = 96, then compares each result with Theo's tally sheet. Theo checks the invoice number, the delivery date, and the customer signature before adding the form to the folder. A note on the original receipt explains why two boxes were moved to a later delivery, so Rina includes that detail in the record. They review the totals once more, sign the page, and scan it with the supporting documents. Theo notes aisle and time, and the initials of the colleague who checked the final balance.

screens.content: Order form 42-B records a return of six boxes. Rina calculates 3/4 - 1/2 = 1/4, then checks that 8 * 12 = 96 and -5 + 13 = 8. Theo reads the figures beside the original packing list, while Rina compares the date, item code, and signature with the return receipt. One handwritten number looks like a three, but the scanned invoice shows an eight, so they correct the copy and mark the source document. Before filing the form, Theo totals the columns again and confirms that the credit matches the recorded quantity. Theo adds the aisle, the time, and the initials who checked the return.

screens.content: Delivery form C-07: 2/3 + 1/6 = 5/6; 9 * 8 = 72; -12 + 20 = 8. The clerk checks each symbol before this form is sent to Oak & Pine. Rina copies the fractions and the negative exactly, then Theo compares the results with the picking sheet. They sign form C-07 after the order number matches the receipt. Rina checks every fraction bar; Theo checks every product. A smudged digit is compared with the original invoice before filing. They attach the signed form to PO-2048 in Room C-07. The minus sign on -16 is copied before the following addend.

screens.content: Return form PO-2048 covers a shipment that arrived with damaged packaging. Rina writes 5/8 - 1/4 = 3/8, 6 * 16 = 96, and -9 + 17 = 8, then compares the results with the supplier note. Theo checks the item code on every box and finds that one carton was entered twice in the first draft. They remove the duplicate, recount the cartons, and ask the driver to initial the corrected quantity. Rina records the adjustment in the return register, while Theo attaches the signed receipt to the form. Rina notes the delivery time, the storage aisle, and the initials of the colleague who checked the cartons.
